create_profiler: create a Profiler instance to mark and measure time intervals for application sections
run_app_profiler: run the singleton AppProfiler to profile application-wide sections with timing and memory data
build_agg_profiler: build an AggProfiler with a sliding window to aggregate profiling statistics across multiple cycles
test_begin_end: test the begin and end methods to record section intervals and accumulate timing data
summarize_get_data: summarize profiling data by calling get_data to retrieve accumulated time, calls, and memory per section
